datasets.name: CMU Graphics Lab complete ASF/AMC
datasets.format: ASF skeletons + AMC motion channels; requires coordinate/rotation conversion before project viewer
datasets.scope: Complete official allasfamc ZIP; not crawling per-motion pages, no C3D/video alternates
datasets.license: Official site: research use free, inclusion in commercially sold products allowed, direct resale of data even converted prohibited; requested acknowledgement retained.
datasets.paired_synchronized: Some CMU sessions contain two actors, but global pairing/task metadata is not verified by downloading archive; must check each selected session.
datasets.coverage: Broad locomotion, daily activities, sports, dance and some interaction; concrete action mapping pending archive inspection.

datasets.name: LAFAN1 complete original BVH
datasets.license: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0. Keep as reference/benchmark; not a freely distributable edited-animation asset.
datasets.scope: Complete original BVH archive: official README states 77 sequences, 5 subjects, 496672 frames; not C3D/FBX duplicates.
datasets.paired_synchronized: Official README: sequences with same theme and take_number recorded simultaneously; pair membership must be verified per take, not assumed for all clips.
datasets.download_note: Media host TLS negotiation failed. Resolved official anonymous Git LFS batch download to signed object URL, preserving TLS verification and official SHA256.

validation: Automatic size, archive hash (official hash for LAFAN1), ZIP CRC and skeleton structure checks, then extraction with space reserve. Not perceptual naturalness approval.
resume: python3 scripts/fetch_transition_expansion.py cmu ; python3 scripts/fetch_transition_expansion.py lafan1 (run separately; supports partial resume)
